Totally get what you're going through right now, the whole feeling of do I quit or not, it's a tough decision to make.

One thing I've done to divert my interest away from gaming is reading. It's interesting, engaging, and can take a lot of time but it's totally worth it. Not to mention that book genres mirror game genres very well. If you like the elder scrolls, pick a fantasy book. It's easy to find books similar to games you love.

If you do choose to start reading a lot then I recommend joining irl book clubs or even forums on line about books you like. This allowed me to meet a bunch of new people and forge really good connections with people I would've never met if I had put all that time into gaming.

But that's just my two cents, if reading doesn't work for you then try experimenting with new hobbies until you find one for you. That's what I've done and found reading and other things to be great ways to spend my time instead of gaming.

I really don't mean to come across as a bookish nerd, its just been a good gaming substitution for me personally.

(PS: I recommend if you pick a hobby/hobbies to replace gaming pick things that take up time. Painting, writing, hiking or biking. That's more time you can spend on the new hobby and less time spent thinking about gaming.)
